compiled_state.title: [per-branch-review.yml]: Top-level workflow name -> Still reads 'Sprint Story Review' after S1 rename
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

S1 (story 908b-11e4-dd14-4ea3 in epic d076-d35e-55db-4843) renamed the file from sprint-story-review.yml to per-branch-review.yml, but the top-level name: field inside the workflow still reads "Sprint Story Review". This causes the GitHub Actions UI to display "Sprint Story Review" for runs of the new file.

Impact is purely cosmetic — GitHub Branch Protection required-check matching uses individual JOB names (e.g., "Per-Story LLM Review", "Actionlint", "ShellCheck"), not the workflow-level name, so the dso.review.check_name=Sprint Story Review config still maps correctly to the per-story-review job.

## Fix
Single-line edit: change line 1 of .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml from "name: Sprint Story Review" to "name: Per-branch Review".

## Notes
Surfaced during workflow scenario validation while remediating bugs 85f3-8301-c1b0-479d and 660e-4317-620d-44bb.

comments.body: REVISED: The workflow display name 'Sprint Story Review' is load-bearing — dso.review.check_name=Sprint Story Review (in dso-config.conf) is the GitHub branch-protection required-check context. Changing the workflow name without coordinated ruleset update would break required-check matching. Three options for a real fix: (1) rename workflow + update dso.review.check_name + update all GitHub Rulesets referencing 'Sprint Story Review' — coordinated multi-step migration; (2) leave name as-is, accept the inconsistency with the renamed file; (3) add a SECOND workflow with the new name + sunset period. Recommendation: defer and leave name as-is. Aborting this fix branch. Priority lowered to P5 / WONTFIX-pending-coordination.
comments.author: Test
